title: E. Howard Hunt's occult novels attacking the Kennedys

tellings.quote: And oh my god, it's an attack on the Kennedys, the Kennedys as Satan worshippers, thinly veiled kind of of a story about that.

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer on secret history, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that E. Howard Hunt, a former CIA officer who also wrote novels, published occult-themed books in the 1960s and 70s, one set on a "Witches Island". Levenda says that, read closely, they are a thinly veiled attack on the Kennedy family, painting them as Satan worshippers.
